findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.comment: On arrival there was not a CFPM available on site. Ensure that a CFPM is available on site at all times that they are in operation.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: A food handler was observed to change gloves without hand washing. Education conducted.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: The temporary hand washing station is observed in the hand sink on arrival and is deem not easily accessible. It was moved so the inspector could wash their hands and then m oved back after. Education conducted. Ensure that the hand washing set up is easily accessible to promote hand washing.
